unreleased.text: While the big glass fills after logging from a reminder, the small glass on the Water card stays hidden until the big one lands in its place.
Water reminder buttons (250 ml / 500 ml) now log the drink without opening the app, and the notification changes to show it was logged and your total for today.
Tapping the water reminder itself opens the app and asks how much you drank: a glass, a bottle or another amount. Then the big glass fills with that amount.
Water and move reminders show the app's icon, with a water or walking picture inside the notification, so they're easy to spot.

items.text: Updates download and install inside the app, with a progress bar. No browser tab needed.
See what's new in each version, with pictures, in Settings → About & updates.
After an update, the app shows what changed the first time you open it.
Previous versions are listed one below another with their changes.
Move reminders: if you've barely moved for a while (you choose 30 min to 2 h, and the hours), you get a nudge to take a short walk. Turn it on in Settings → Move reminders.
Water: a drop falls into the glass when you tap +250 or +500. When you log from a reminder notification, a big glass fills in the middle of the screen and then shrinks into the small one.

Steps by the hour: tap the Move card on Home to see today's steps as a chart, with your walks found and named for you (for example Morning walk, Brisk evening walk, Night stroll). No need to log walks yourself.
The Steps page has Day, Week, Month and Year views, with a goal line, your best day and totals.
Calories burned now count all your steps, not just logged walks and workouts. Each walk shows its own calories.
Update downloads use Android's downloader, so they no longer get stuck at 100%.
Fixed meal macros failing when the AI replied in words instead of numbers (for example, meals with cabbage).
Works with both the free Gemini AI and Claude.
The project is now public. Anyone can download the app from GitHub Releases.
The app checks for updates when you open it, and Home shows a banner when a new version is out.
Settings → About & updates has a Check for updates button.
The coach's bullet-point tips show as a proper list.
A first-time setup that collects your name, body, goal, daily targets, AI choice and phone connections. Every page can be skipped.
Settings grouped by category: Profile, Body, Goals, AI, Water reminders, Health Connect, Theme & colour, Data & backup.
A free AI (Gemini) works out of the box. Claude with your own key is still an option.
Health Connect reads your phone's steps, and shares meals, water, walks, workouts, weight and sleep with Google Health.
The app icon follows your accent colour.
Press back again to exit.
Prompts appear when a feature needs details you haven't given yet.
Fixed the body-fat formula, which read about 6 points too high.
The first Android app: the floating island stays put, the back button works, and water reminders arrive with the app closed.
Your data is stored on the phone and kept by Android's own backup.
